name: Break Up
overview: Scripture teaches that God is close to those with broken hearts and contrite spirits, offering comfort and salvation in times of emotional distress. The call to "break up your fallow ground" encourages repentance and seeking the Lord earnestly, preparing the heart for His righteousness. While God hates putting away, reflecting His desire for faithfulness and integrity in relationships, believers are reminded to trust in Christ and not let their hearts be troubled, finding hope in God's love and the promise of everlasting life through Him.
